transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you in to see me?

Well, what finally brought me in is that I just don't feel like myself anymore. I used to always make time for things I enjoyed—painting, hiking, singing in my choir, and going to Sunday family gatherings. But lately... even when I have a free hour, I just sit there. I'm just unable to care about any of it right now.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
I'd say it's been building for about eight months now. It really started right around the time I took over the STEM-Arts curriculum initiative at work.
Along with losing interest in your usual activities, have you also been feeling down, sad, or hopeless most of the time?

Yes, I have. It's like... most days I feel like there's this heavy gray film over everything. I can be standing right there in a classroom full of students, or just at home with my husband, and I still feel completely hollow. I'm just close to tears a lot of the time.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt this low or lost interest in things like this?

No, I haven't. I mean, I've had normal bad days or stressful weeks before, but... no, nothing like this. I've never had a time in my life where I felt this empty for so long. This is really the first time.
Have you ever had times when you felt unusually energized, wired, or on top of the world, needing much less sleep than usual?

No, I haven't. I mean... I've never really felt wired or on top of the world like that. I've always needed my regular amount of sleep. So, no, I haven't experienced anything like what you're describing.
How has your sleep been during these past few months?

It's been all over the place for months, honestly. I'll just lie awake at night, um, replaying grant details and work stuff in my head. Then I usually end up waking up around three or four in the morning. And... even on the nights when I do manage to sleep a bit longer, I still get up feeling like I never actually rested.
Have you been feeling down on yourself, or experiencing strong feelings of guilt or worthlessness?

Yeah, I have been. Um... it happens a lot at work. If anything goes wrong with the curriculum project I'm helping with, even just a really small thing, I get really down on myself. I just keep thinking that I'm letting the students down. And... I don't know, I just feel like I'm wasting all the sacrifices my parents made for me to even have this kind of opportunity in the first place.
With everything feeling so heavy lately, have you had any thoughts of wanting to give up, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Well... yes, I have. I haven't made an actual plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But sometimes, especially on late nights in the studio, I just catch myself thinking that it would be a relief if I didn't wake up. And... honestly, those thoughts really scare me. They scared me enough that I finally told my husband I just couldn't keep handling them alone anymore.
